items.headline: Markets (wk of Sep 21): US equities ground higher despite a bond selloff — S&P 500 ~7,743, Nasdaq ~27,069; 10-yr Treasury ~5.18% (highest since GFC, 30-yr ~5.48%); oil slid toward $92 on easing Gulf tensions; Fed stayed hawkish (Williams: another hike by year-end 'reasonable'), Oct hike odds ~70%
Cyera raised a $400M Series G extension at a $12B+ valuation (Sep 22, Goldman Sachs Alternatives) — AI/data-security control plane; 2026 fundraising past ~$1.4B, total >$2.7B
Island raised a $400M Series F at a $6.4B valuation (Sep 24, led by Evolution Equity Partners) — enterprise browser + AI-governance layer; more than doubled its 2024 mark

Anthropic shipped Claude Opus 5.5 (Sep 22) — first of a new 5.5 family; matches Fable 5.1 on most work at ~40% lower run-cost ($4/$20 per M tokens), ~30% faster output, leads Terminal-Bench/OSWorld agentic benchmarks

Figure unveiled Helix 2.5 (Sep 17; Forbes Sep 21) — robots completed chores in 30 unseen homes at 56% zero-shot (6x jump from 9%), the entire gain traced to training on 'Index,' its ~$1B crowdsourced human-activity dataset (same robot/architecture)
Enveda raised a $311M Series E (Sep 23) for AI drug discovery — from Catalio, Durable Capital, ICONIQ, Lightspeed, Surveyor
Precision Neuroscience raised a $250M Series D (Sep 24), co-led by Ackman's Pershing Square + Ackman-Oxman Institute (total ~$430M) — funds FDA review of its Layer 7 cortical brain-computer interface
Rightway raised a $155M Series E (Sep 24) — healthcare-navigation/PBM platform led by Francisco Partners with Thrive Capital and Khosla; now serves 45 Fortune 500 employers, scaling AI features
Y Combinator will now let batch companies take their standard investment in stablecoins (up to $500K) instead of fiat — a structural signal for early-stage deal mechanics / crypto rails
OpenAI released GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6 Sol (Sep 22), two new variants following GPT-6 Astra — extending GPT-6 into a task-tiered family, competing on price/latency segmentation

Agent-native tools shipped: Ando exited stealth (~$20M) as team-messaging where AI agents are first-class participants (Sep 24), and Strada shipped agent record/replay automation inside legacy portals with audit logs (Sep 24)
Learn: 'Multi-Agent Workflows in Claude Code: Skills, Subagents & Handoffs' (YouTube) — builder-grade walkthrough of orchestrating multiple Claude Code agents

Learn: 2026 cognitive-offloading research (Frontiers in Psychology; Shen & Tamkin developer study) — heavy AI use produces working output while eroding conceptual understanding/debugging ability; FAU teaching material

Markets (wk of Sep 14): Fed hiked 25bps to 3.75-4.00% on Sep 16 — first hike in 3 years, unanimous, dot plot signals one more hike in 2026; Nasdaq +2.6% (~26,523), S&P 500 +0.7% (~7,650), Dow -733 pts; 10-yr Treasury briefly above 5.0%
Profound raised $180M Series D at ~$1.8B valuation (Sep 15), co-led by Sequoia and Kleiner Perkins — 'answer engine optimization' (AEO), measuring/shaping brand visibility inside AI answer engines

Anthropic disclosed (Sep 17-18) that Claude now LEADS ~26% of its own model R&D (up from 0% in February), completing tasks end-to-end from a high-level prompt under human supervision; ~90% of R&D done 'in collaboration' with Claude

OpenAI (Sep 17) published a formal framework for tracking/probing/disclosing model 'misalignment' and named six reports of concerning behavior; separately began testing 'Sponsored Agents' ads in ChatGPT

Temporal raised $550M Series E at a $12.55B valuation (Sep 14), led by Lightspeed — 'durable execution' reliability infra for agentic AI; ~$250M ARR (+200% YoY); customers OpenAI, Cursor, Netflix, JPMorgan
Impulse Space closed ~$308M for in-space (orbital transfer) vehicles — one of the two largest venture rounds of the week (Sep 12-18)

Factory raised $200M at a $5B valuation (Sep 15) from Blackstone, Khosla, Sequoia (angels Gerstner, Benioff) — 'self-improving software factories' for enterprise engineering; tripled valuation in five months

Anthropic shipped 'Claude for Small Business' (Sep 15): 43 workflows + 27 connectors (Shopify, Salesforce, Zoom, Xero, Gusto, Square, Stripe, Zapier), plus a Claude for Financial Advisors plugin with audit logs for RIA recordkeeping
Tandem Health raised €86.5M (~$100M) Series B (Sep 14) for clinical AI documentation/software, scaling across European health systems (Stockholm)
Cognition (Devin) hit a $48B valuation on ~$900M run-rate and Harvey (legal AI) reached $15.5B ($550M, Sep 9) — application-layer AI companies priced at foundation-model scale
Robotics startups raised ~$55.8B in 2026 (Dealroom), already nearly double all of 2025; state capital (China ~$138B AI/robotics fund) now a structural force in physical-AI funding
Reid Hoffman calls for a new, pragmatic political approach to AI focused on practical near-term benefits (WaPo, Sep 16)
NHTSA opened an investigation into Tesla's self-certification that the Cybercab (no wheel/pedals, camera-only) meets federal motor-vehicle safety standards, as paid unsupervised rides run in TX/FL
Cohere in advanced talks to raise $2-3B at a ~$20B valuation (roughly double its early-2025 mark), reportedly including the Canadian government; a marquee test of the 'sovereign AI' thesis

YC Summer 2026 Demo Day (Sep 10) presented 234 companies to ~1,500 investors; Industrials jumped to ~23% of the batch, with founders clustering around agents that do work, agent-safety infra, and AI in the physical world
